mod.name: Arranger: Pinned Tracks
mod.author: Silent Orbit
mod.description: Like Cubase's 'Divide Track List': pinned tracks stay in a fixed area at the top of the arranger, the other tracks scroll below it, with a thin divider in between. Right-click a top-level track: 'Pin to Top' adds #pin to its comment, 'Unpin' removes it (undoable). Needs Framework: Actions and Menus.
